set.body:
Outcome

Use the canonical locus4s language directly and remove aliases or renamed constructors that create a second finite-domain vocabulary.

Work

- Replace scalafim.locus wildcard imports across atlas, connectivity, dataset, image, latent, MVPA, spatial, surface, threshold, and tests.
- Replace SpaceKey-as-DomainId usage with the precise upstream identity concept required at each call site.
- Replace sameIdentityAs with sameRuntimeOwnerAs, samePersistentIdentityAs, or align according to the actual contract.
- Replace Point with Index and IndexedField requirements with representation-neutral Field unless VectorField storage is truly required.
- Replace mapping, requirePoint, and similar renamings with canonical upstream APIs.
- Delete MapEvidence and call Injection.fromTotalMap, Surjection.fromTotalMap, and Bijection.fromTotalMap directly.
- Introduce only narrow role vocabulary within the scientific module that gives the role meaning.

Acceptance

- No broad scalafim.locus package facade remains.
- Every former sameIdentityAs call explicitly names runtime ownership, persistent identity, or alignment.
- Generic APIs consume Field rather than the compatibility VectorField alias.
- A repository search demonstrates no production dependency on transitional Point/IndexedField vocabulary.
- Public source compatibility changes are documented without retaining duplicate algorithms.
set.title: Remove scalafim.locus facade vocabulary and MapEvidence
